$comment: Adapters that read wallet token balances directly and aggregate them into a single protocol-denominated PositionBalance (e.g. Cap reads balanceOf(cUsd)+balanceOf(stcUsd) and returns the combined amount in USDC). For these, the wallet tokens are NOT registered as standalone priceable assets in NAV's asset registry, but they ARE in NAV's economic coverage via the adapter. Both refresh-integration-snapshot.sh (anchor) and generate-comparison-report.py (rendered rows) read this file so their filtered-DeBank totals share one allowlist. Map: adapter_key (as it appears under chains/<cid>.json.balanceAdapters) -> list of constructor param names whose values are the wallet token addresses to credit. Add a new wallet-aggregating adapter with one entry here.
